description: No computably enumerable predicate of actual theorem codes is both sound and weakly complete for full second-order arithmetic validity.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderValidity.no_effective_completeness (P : ℕ → Prop) (hP : REPred P) :
  ¬(Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderValidity.Sound P ∧
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderValidity.WeaklyComplete P)
